android.desc:
Simple TV Launcher replaces the home screen on Android TV boxes and provides a straightforward way to open your installed applications.

Choose the applications you want to access from the home screen, or open the application grid to browse your apps. The home screen also displays a clock and provides access to Android system settings.

This app is a launcher: it helps you open applications already installed on your device. It does not include TV channels, movies or other video content. Available applications and system settings depend on your device.

The source code is available at https://github.com/alescdb/LauncherTV

Icon by Vojtech M.
Czech and Slovak translations by Vojtech M.
